lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. The w42 scripts did not survive the container change, so windows were re-cut in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/bd010ea5-6deb-54d2-81da-591cf8fca07a/scratchpad/raterB43/ (d.py diff fractions, h.py signed diff and heat maps, c.py / c2.py cover boxes found from the r42->r43 diff components plus fixed boxes, b.py belt-signature mask, m.py q15 pillow / back / pan / far windows). Absolute numbers from m.py are NOT comparable to w42b values (new windows); deltas r42->r43 are. Change fractions r42->r43 (px with max channel diff > 6): q15 11.1 %, q16 20.4 %, q17 2.0 % - almost all low-amplitude lighting change (mean dRGB on fabric px +0.1/+0.5/+2.6 in q15, +0.3/+0.9/+3.4 in q16), with the large deltas on the navy headrest covers and the belts. Studio: e4 7.0 % (cover + wings), e1 3.0 %, e7 1.1 %, e11 1.0 % (belts), e4b 0.7 %, e2 / e5 / e8 / e10 bit-identical, rest < 0.05 %. No econ geometry changed.

priorIssues.note: q16 cover components (mid 70 % of L, r42 -> r43): near-left (201-313, 402-526) 44.9 -> 64.6, RGB (65,73,119) B/R 1.83, vs y_47301 near cover 58.3 B/R 1.72 - now matched; second-row left (303-357, 256-310) 36.5 -> 56.3 and (209-254, 242-290) 58.4 -> 85.5 vs photo 73-82; centre-block covers facing the camera (417-482, 273-333) 34.1 -> 39.2. Right-block covers (740-835, 330-400) 48.3 -> 48.5 and (830-920, 262-300) 56.9 -> 57.3, unchanged, vs y_47301 102 / 158. q15 head-on darkest 40 %: 46.1/47.5/47.3/46.0 -> 50.1/47.8/47.7/50.0, B/R 1.96-2.03, vs y_47300 56.8/43.3/36.3/33.8 (B/R 1.69-2.03) - still inside the photo range, mean 48.9 vs 42.6, outer two now 6-16 L above the photo's right-hand pair.

Geometry unchanged (09a_econ.js:299-302 tucked branch). The navy stub and silver tongue still read under every q15 pillow (x 215-240 / 370-395 / 525-550 / 690-715 at y 505-515), where y_47300 shows only the cover.

Far window (330-600, 160-215) moved < 1 L: L 113.6 -> 114.2 / 101.7 -> 102.3, p90/p10 3.83 -> 3.64 / 3.07 -> 2.96. With this window the photo is 99.7 / 93.3, 3.05 / 3.13, highlight share 13.6 / 11.0 % vs render 17.6 / 13.0 % - i.e. with the re-cut window the far rows are not worse than the photo; the w42 shortfall depended on the old window. Treat as closed-to-low.

Pillow geometry unchanged; e4b 0.66 % changed (lighting). q15 pillow p90/p10 2.54/2.54/2.65/2.45 (r42 2.59/2.55/2.56/2.48) vs y_47300 3.29/2.77/2.72/2.85 in matching boxes. Still a flat plaque without corner ears or a centre crown.
e11 dark px (L<45) per 40-row band from y 200: 1094/6573/9207/9553/5431/1145/437, bit-identical to s42.
09a_econ.js:291-296 unchanged: three flat gBox segments at stepped panY. e11 navy strap still shows two saw-tooth risers between the crease and the latch (x 140-280, y 160-190); same in e7 left seat.

yBelt #2d5c90 -> #42648f. Belt-signature px (r42 B/R>3.5, G/R>1.8, B>90): q15 2339 px (29,70,139) -> (38,75,139) B/R 4.8 -> 3.7; q16 881 px (29,79,141) -> (47,88,141) B/R 4.9 -> 3.0; q17 right block 1372 px (26,65,129) -> (36,70,129) B/R 3.6. Shaded photo webbing y_47300 / y_47301 B/R 1.3-1.9. Red went up 9-18, blue did not drop, so the in-cabin straps are still royal blue; part of the remaining chroma is the shaded-fill tint (lighting).
Latch still at z2 -0.33, x2 0.03; q17 right-block straps still 30-40 px stubs by the armrests vs y_47303's 70-90 px straps hanging to the pan front.

details.refs: q15 back D L 88.5 p90/p10 3.23 vs y_47300 91.7 / 3.35. Back F still light: 89.8 vs 69.0 (w42a-6). Sheen tint shifted fabric B/R 2.15 -> 2.19 (q15), photo mid-backs 2.23 - fine.

Up 0.1: q16 near-left cover 64.6 vs photo 58.3 (was 44.9), second-row left 56-86 vs 73-82; q15 still in the photo range. Held below 9 because the right-block q16 covers stay at 48-57 vs 102-158 and the q17 cover still reads as a narrow strip under the wing (w42a-4).

Held. In-cabin chroma down (B/R 4.9 -> 3.0-3.7) but still royal blue vs slate 1.3-1.9; lit studio tongue strap went from (79,165,216) to (122,176,215), now paler than y_47303's lit webbing (65-87, 116-136, 181-183) (w43b-2). Stair-step and stubs unchanged.
e11 dark bands bit-identical; pan lightness gap is lighting.
Up 0.1 on re-measure, not on change: with the re-cut window the far rows match y_47300 (L 114 / 102 vs 100 / 93, p90/p10 3.64 / 2.96 vs 3.05 / 3.13). r42 -> r43 delta < 1 L.

issues.title: In-cabin belts still royal blue; the #42648f change raised red but left the chroma high
issues.evidence: Belt px q15 (38,75,139) B/R 3.7, q16 (47,88,141) B/R 3.0, q17 (36,70,129) B/R 3.6 vs shaded webbing in y_47300 / y_47301 (35-65, 42-79, 61-122) B/R 1.3-1.9. The lit studio strap is already too pale (w43b-2), so lifting lightness further is wrong; the in-cabin blue comes from the cool shaded fill on a saturated base.
issues.fix: Desaturate rather than lighten: yBelt '#42648f' -> '#4a5f7e' (B/R 1.7, same L). Lighting owner: check whether the shaded fill on non-fabric materials adds blue (compare a neutral grey material in the q15 pan shadow).
issues.check: b.py belt mask: B/R <= 2.2 in q15 / q16 / q17 and e11 tongue strap G/R >= 1.4, L within 110-140.

issues.title: Lit tongue strap now paler and greyer than the photo's teal webbing
issues.fix: Give the tongue strap its own colour, e.g. { ...SEATMAT.yBelt, c: '#3f6f96' }, so the teal/slate tongue strap and the shared yBelt can be tuned separately.
issues.check: e11 sample (345-360, 150-160) within +-20 per channel of (75,125,182).

issues.title: Carried: draped straps stair-step
issues.evidence: e11 / e7 navy strap still shows two risers; geometry unchanged.
issues.fix: One box per strap, length = full hypot, pitched by -atan(0.0875) about the strap's lateral axis (compose M4.trs(... yaw) with a rotX), centred at panY(mid z)+0.004.
issues.check: e11 navy strap edge row (x 140-280) monotonic: no column-to-column jumps > 2 px in the strap's top edge.

issues.title: Side-block pillows sit over the draped belts in q17 (photo conflict)
issues.evidence: q17 right block shows a navy pillow on each seat (x 560-640, y 230-420); y_47301 / y_47303 side blocks have none, but y_47300's left block (x 100-160, y 310-355) does have one. Rule: real-photo geometry wins, and all three official photos are real photos, so this is a staging conflict.
issues.fix: Drop the pillow where opts.drape (the side blocks in the q16 / q17 views), keep it on the centre block, matching the majority of photos.
issues.check: q17 right-block navy px (B/R>1.8, L<45) in x 540-660, y 220-430 drops by > 60 %.

issues.title: Carried: q17 headrest cover reads as a narrow strip under the wing
issues.evidence: q17 near right seat shows a 15-20 px pale strip (x 670-700, y 100-200); y_47303 shows a 120x95 px grey flap over the headrest front.
issues.fix: As in w42a: drop the cover 3-4 cm and bring it 1 cm proud of the wing pads so it overlaps them, as in the photos.
issues.check: q17 cover px share in the near headrest box >= 2x r43.

issues.title: Carried: q17 straps are stubs
issues.check: q17 right-block belt mask px >= 2000 with strap reaching within 30 px of the pan front.

issues.title: Carried: centre-block navy stubs and tongue under the pillows
issues.check: q15 navy/silver px under the four pillows (y 500-520) -> < 50 % of r43.

issues.title: Carried: pillow a flat plaque
issues.fix: Pillow loft: corners out 1.5 cm, mid-edges pinched 1 cm, centre 1 cm thicker.

issues.title: Carried: fleck contrast low
issues.fix: Raise the fleck swatch gain about 10 % at the same mean.

issues.title: Carried: black edge under the pan front
issues.check: e11 L<45 px in band y 280-320 drops by > 30 %.

issues.title: Widened sheen lifts only the covers seen obliquely; right-block q16 covers still 45-100 L dark
issues.evidence: q16 right-block covers 48.5 / 57.3 vs y_47301 102 / 158 (unchanged from r42); q15 outer covers now 50 vs photo's right pair 34-36.
issues.fix: Not scored. Lighting owner: check the q16 right-block cover fill (it is the brightest cover area in y_47301 - window light from the right).
issues.check: q16 (740-835, 330-400) mid-70 L >= 70 without q15 covers exceeding 57.

questionsForUser: The official photos disagree on lumbar pillows on the 3-seat side blocks (present in y_47300, absent in y_47301 / y_47303). Should the side blocks carry pillows?
extraRefsSearched: No downloads. Used ref/ana y_47300 (q15 covers, pillows, backs, pans, far rows), y_47301 (q16 covers, fabric, shaded belts) and y_47303 (q17 webbing, cover flap).
